sentences.zh: 常思，字克恭，太原人也。

translations.literal: Chang Si, style name Kegong, was a native of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Si, whose style name was Kegong, came from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 父仁嶽，河東牙將，累贈太子太師。

translations.literal: His father Ren Yue was a Hedong military adjutant and was repeatedly posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ren Yue had served as a military adjutant in Hedong and was posthumously honored on several occasions as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 唐莊宗之為晉王也，廣募勝兵，時思以趫悍應募，累從戎役，後為長直都校，歷捧聖軍使。

translations.literal: When Tang Zhuangzong was Prince of Jin he widely recruited elite soldiers; Si at the time enlisted on account of his swift daring, took part repeatedly in campaigns, later became chief officer of the Changzhi Guard, and successively served as commander of the Fengsheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong of Tang was still Prince of Jin, he recruited elite troops on a wide scale; Si enlisted then for his swift, fierce prowess, fought in campaign after campaign, later became chief officer of the Long-Duty Guard, and in time rose to command the Fengsheng Army.

sentences.zh: 晉初，遷六軍都虞候。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jin period he was promoted to chief inspector of the Six Armies.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jin period he was transferred to chief inspector of the Six Armies.

sentences.zh: 漢高祖出鎮並門，奏以思從行，尋表為河東牢城都指揮使，以勤幹見稱。

translations.literal: When Han Gaozu went out to govern Bingmen he memorialized that Si should accompany him; soon afterward he was recommended as commander of the Hedong fortress garrison and won praise for diligence and competence.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu of Han took up his post at Bing Gate, he had Si accompany him by memorial; Si was soon appointed commander of the Hedong fortress garrison and became known for his diligent, capable service.

sentences.zh: 漢國初建，授檢校太保，遙領鄧州。

translations.literal: When the Han state was first established he was appointed acting Grand Guardian and given nominal charge of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the Han state he received the acting title Grand Guardian and was given nominal jurisdiction over Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 漢有天下，遷檢校太尉、昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: When Han held the realm he was transferred to acting Grand Marshal and made military governor of Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Once Han held the empire, he was promoted to acting Grand Marshal and appointed military governor of Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 乾佑初，李守貞叛於河中，太祖征之，朝廷命思帥部兵以副焉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyou, Li Shouzhen rebelled at Hezhong; Taizu campaigned against him, and the court ordered Si to lead his troops as a supporting force.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianyou, Li Shouzhen rebelled at Hezhong; Taizu marched against him, and the court ordered Si to lead his division in support.

sentences.zh: 既而禦眾無能，勒歸舊藩。

translations.literal: Before long he proved unable to command the troops and was ordered back to his former commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he proved unable to handle the troops and was ordered to return to his former fief.

sentences.zh: 思在上黨凡五年，無令譽可稱，唯以聚斂為務，性又鄙吝，未嘗與賓佐有酒肴之會。

translations.literal: Si spent five years altogether at Shangdang with no reputation worth mentioning; he devoted himself solely to extortion, and by nature he was mean and stingy, never once hosting his staff with food and wine.
translations.idiomatic: Si spent five years in all at Shangdang without a reputation worth the name; he devoted himself solely to squeezing revenue, and by nature he was coarse and miserly—he never once shared food and wine with his staff.

sentences.zh: 嘗有從事欲求謁見者，思覽刺而怒曰：「彼必是來獵酒也。」

translations.literal: Once a staff member sought an audience; Si read his calling card and said angrily, "He must be coming to hunt for wine.
translations.idiomatic: Once a staff member asked to see him; Si read the calling card and snapped, "He must be coming to scrounge wine.

sentences.zh: 命典客者飲而遣之，其鄙吝也如是。

translations.literal: He ordered the usher to give him drink and send him away—such was his stinginess.
translations.idiomatic: He told the usher to give the man a drink and send him away—such was his meanness.

sentences.zh: 太祖受命，就加平章事。

translations.literal: When Taizu received the Mandate he was immediately given the title of Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu received the Mandate, Si was at once made a Councilor of State.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖微時，以季父待思，及即位，遣其妻入覲，太祖拜之如家人之禮，仍呼曰叔母，其恩顧如是。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Taizu was still obscure, he had treated Si as a younger uncle; after his accession he sent Si's wife to court for an audience, and Taizu bowed to her with the courtesy due a kinswoman and still addressed her as Aunt—such was the favor shown him.
translations.idiomatic: In the old days, when Taizu was still obscure, he had treated Si as a younger uncle; after he took the throne he had Si's wife come to court, bowed to her with the courtesy of family, and still called her Aunt—such was the grace he showed them.

sentences.zh: 廣順二年秋，思來朝，加兼侍中，移鎮宋州。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year of Guangshun, Si came to court, was given the additional title of Palace Attendant, and was transferred to govern Song Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Guangshun year two, Si came to court, was given the additional title of Palace Attendant, and was transferred to Song Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三年夏，詔赴闕，改授平盧軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year an edict summoned him to the capital and he was reassigned as military governor of Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of year three he was summoned to court by edict and reassigned as military governor of Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 思將赴鎮，奏太祖云：「臣在宋州出鎮，得絲十餘萬兩，謹以上進，請行征督。」

translations.literal: As Si was about to take up his new post he memorialized Taizu, saying, "When I left my post at Song Prefecture I had more than a hundred thousand taels of silk, which I respectfully present to Your Majesty; please levy and collect it.
translations.idiomatic: As Si was about to leave for his new command he memorialized Taizu: "When I departed Song Prefecture I had more than a hundred thousand taels of silk, which I respectfully offer upward; please have it levied and collected.

sentences.zh: 太祖頷之，尋詔本州折券以諭其民。

translations.literal: Taizu nodded assent, and soon an edict ordered that prefecture to cancel the bonds and inform the people.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu nodded, and soon an edict ordered that prefecture to cancel the tax bonds and notify the people.

sentences.zh: 及到鎮，未幾，染風痹之疾，上表請尋醫，既而舁疾歸洛。

translations.literal: After he reached his post, before long he contracted wind-paralysis; he memorialized asking to seek medical treatment and was soon carried home ill to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after he reached his post he fell ill with wind paralysis; he memorialized asking permission to seek a physician, and was soon carried home to Luoyang on a litter.

sentences.zh: 顯德元年春卒，年六十有九。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Xiande he died, aged sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Xiande year one he died, at the age of sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 贈中書令。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 翟光鄴，字化基，濮州鄄城人。

translations.literal: Di Guangye, style name Huaji, was a native of Juancheng in Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Di Guangye, whose style name was Huaji, came from Juancheng in Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 父景珂，倜儻有膽氣。

translations.literal: His father Jing Ke was bold and free-spirited and had courage.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jing Ke was bold and daring by nature.

sentences.zh: 梁貞明初，唐莊宗始駐軍於河上，景珂率聚邑人守永定驛，固守逾年，後為北軍所攻，景珂戰歿，眾潰。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhenming of Liang, Tang Zhuangzong first stationed his army on the Yellow River; Jing Ke led the people of his district to hold Yongding Post, defended it for more than a year, and was later attacked by the northern army; Jing Ke died in battle and the host scattered.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Liang Zhenming, Zhuangzong of Tang first encamped his army on the Yellow River; Jing Ke led the people of his district to hold Yongding Post, held firm for more than a year, was later attacked by the northern army, fell in battle, and his force broke.

sentences.zh: 光鄴時年十歲，為明宗軍所俘，以其穎悟，俾侍左右，字之曰永定。

translations.literal: Guangye was then ten years old; he was captured by Mingzong's army, and because he was clever they had him attend at the ruler's side and gave him the style name Yongding.
translations.idiomatic: Guangye was then ten; Mingzong's army captured him, and because he was bright they had him wait at the ruler's side and gave him the style name Yongding.

sentences.zh: 既冠，沈毅有謀，蒞事寡過。

translations.literal: After he came of age he was steady and resolute, full of plans, and rarely erred in office.
translations.idiomatic: Once he came of age he was grave, resolute, and resourceful, and rarely erred in office.

sentences.zh: 明宗即位，時深委遇，累遷至皇城使、檢校司空。

translations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne Guangye was deeply trusted and in time rose to Imperial City Commissioner and acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong acceded, Guangye enjoyed his deep trust and in time rose to Imperial City Commissioner and acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 長興中，樞密使安重誨得罪，時光鄴與中官孟小僧頗有力焉。

translations.literal: During Changxing, when Chief Councilor An Chonghui fell from favor, Guangye at the time had considerable influence together with the eunuch Meng Xiaoseng.
translations.idiomatic: During Changxing, when Chief Councilor An Chonghui fell from favor, Guangye and the eunuch Meng Xiaoseng had played a considerable part.

sentences.zh: 居無何，出為耀州團練使。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent out as regimental commissioner of Yao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was sent out as regimental commissioner of Yao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清泰初，入為左監門衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingtai he entered service as Grand General of the Left Directorate of the Gate Guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingtai he entered court service as Grand General of the Left Directorate of the Gate Guards.

sentences.zh: 晉天福中，歷棣沂二州刺史、西京副留守。

translations.literal: During Jin Tianfu he successively served as prefect of Di and Yi prefectures and as deputy defender of the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: During Jin Tianfu he served in turn as prefect of Di and Yi and as deputy defender of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 開運初，授宣徽使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyun he was appointed Commissioner of the Palace Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaiyun he was appointed Commissioner of the Palace Directorate.

sentences.zh: 楊光遠叛滅，青州平，除為防禦使，朝廷以兵亂之後，人物雕弊，故命光鄴理之。

translations.literal: When Yang Guangyuan's rebellion was crushed and Qingzhou pacified, he was made defense commissioner; because after the military turmoil the population was devastated, the court ordered Guangye to administer the region.
translations.idiomatic: After Yang Guangyuan's rebellion was crushed and Qingzhou pacified, he was made defense commissioner; the court, seeing how war had ravaged the region and thinned the population, put Guangye in charge of restoring it.

sentences.zh: 光鄴好聚書，重儒者，虛齋論議，惟求理道。

translations.literal: Guangye loved to collect books, honored Confucian scholars, and in his empty study held discussions seeking only the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Guangye loved to gather books, honored Confucian scholars, and in his quiet study held discussions aimed solely at principle.

sentences.zh: 時郡民喪亡十之六七，而招懷撫諭，視之如傷，故期月之間，流亡載輯。

translations.literal: At the time six or seven tenths of the prefecture's people had perished, yet he recruited, comforted, and instructed them, treating their wounds as his own, so that within a month exiles were returning in crowds.
translations.idiomatic: Six or seven tenths of the prefecture's people had died, yet he recruited, comforted, and instructed the survivors as though tending the wounded, and within a month refugees were streaming back.

sentences.zh: 契丹入汴，偽命權知曹州。

translations.literal: When the Khitan entered Bian, a puppet appointment made him acting prefect of Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan entered Bian, a puppet regime named him acting prefect of Cao.

sentences.zh: 李從益假號，以光鄴明宗舊臣，署為樞密使。

translations.literal: Li Congyi assumed a false title and, because Guangye was an old minister of Mingzong, appointed him Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Congyi took a false title; because Guangye was an old minister of Mingzong, he appointed him Chief Councilor.

sentences.zh: 漢祖至汴，改左領衛大將軍。

translations.literal: When the Han founder reached Bian he was changed to Grand General of the Left Leading Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han founder reached Bian, Guangye was reassigned as Grand General of the Left Leading Guard.

sentences.zh: 乾祐初，遷右金吾衛大將軍，充街使、檢校太保。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyou he was promoted to Grand General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, served as street commissioner, and was given the acting title Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyou year one he was promoted to Grand General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, made street commissioner, and given the acting title Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 太祖踐阼，復授宣徽使、左千牛衛上將軍、檢校太傅。

translations.literal: When Taizu took the throne he was again appointed Commissioner of the Palace Directorate, Grand General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard, and acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu acceded he was again made Commissioner of the Palace Directorate, Grand General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard, and acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 數月，兼樞密副使。

translations.literal: Several months later he was also made Deputy Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later he was also made Deputy Chief Councilor.

sentences.zh: 會永興李洪信入朝，代知軍府事。

translations.literal: When Li Hongxin of Yongxing came to court, Guangye acted in his stead as administrator of the military government.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Hongxin of Yongxing came to court, Guangye acted in his stead administering the military government.

sentences.zh: 廣順二年十月，卒於長安，時年四十六。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year of Guangshun he died at Chang'an, aged forty-six.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Guangshun year two he died at Chang'an, aged forty-six.

sentences.zh: 光鄴有器度，慎密敦厚，出於天然，喜慍不形於色。

translations.literal: Guangye had breadth of character, was cautious, close, and generous by nature, and never let pleasure or anger show on his face.
translations.idiomatic: Guangye had breadth of manner, was cautious, steady, and generous by nature, and never let joy or anger show on his face.

sentences.zh: 事繼母以孝聞，兄弟皆雍睦。

translations.literal: He was known for filial devotion to his stepmother, and his brothers all lived in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: He was famed for filial care of his stepmother, and his brothers all lived in harmony.

sentences.zh: 雖食祿日久，家無餘財，任金吾日，假官屋數間以蔽風雨，親族累重，糲食才給，人不堪其憂，光鄴處之晏如也。

translations.literal: Though he had drawn salary for many years his household had no surplus; while serving as Golden Crow commissioner he borrowed a few government rooms to shelter from wind and rain; his kin were numerous and coarse grain barely sufficed—others could not bear such hardship, yet Guangye dwelt in perfect ease.
translations.idiomatic: Though he had held office and drawn salary for years, his household had no surplus; as Golden Crow commissioner he borrowed a few government rooms against wind and rain; kin crowded about him and coarse grain barely fed them—others would have found it unbearable, but Guangye remained perfectly at ease.

sentences.zh: 賓朋至，則貰酒延之，談說終日，略無厭倦，士大夫多之。

translations.literal: When guests came he would buy wine on credit to entertain them, talking all day without the least weariness, and the scholar-official class esteemed him.
translations.idiomatic: When guests arrived he would buy wine on credit to entertain them, talking the day through without tiring, and men of letters held him in esteem.

sentences.zh: 及權知京兆，以寬靜為治，前政有煩苛之事，一切停罷，百姓便之。

translations.literal: When he acted for Jingzhao he governed with leniency and quiet; whatever vexatious or harsh measures the previous administration had imposed he halted entirely, to the people's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: When he acted for Jingzhao he governed with leniency and calm; every vexatious or harsh measure of the previous regime he stopped at once, to the people's relief.

sentences.zh: 及病甚，召親隨於臥內，戒之曰：「氣絕之後，以屍歸洛，不得於此停留，慮煩軍府。」

translations.literal: When his illness grew severe he summoned his close attendants to his bedside and charged them, saying, "After my breath stops, take my body back to Luoyang; do not let it remain here, lest it burden the military government.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness grew grave he summoned his close attendants to his bedside and charged them: "When my breath stops, take my body back to Luoyang; do not leave it here, lest you trouble the military government.

sentences.zh: 言訖而終。

translations.literal: When he had finished speaking he died.
translations.idiomatic: He finished speaking and died.

sentences.zh: 京兆吏如喪所親，或有以漿酒遙奠者。

translations.literal: The officials of Jingzhao mourned as for a close kinsman; some even poured libations of gruel and wine from afar.
translations.idiomatic: The officials of Jingzhao mourned him as they would a kinsman; some even poured libations of gruel and wine from afar.

sentences.zh: 樞密使王峻素重光鄴，且欲厚恤其家，為之上請，故自終及葬，所賜賻赗幾數千計。

translations.literal: Chief Councilor Wang Jun had always held Guangye in high regard and wished to enrich his family; he memorialized on their behalf, so from death through burial the gifts of condolence money amounted to several thousand items.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councilor Wang Jun had always esteemed Guangye and wished to enrich his household; he memorialized on their behalf, so from death through burial the gifts of condolence money ran to several thousand items.

sentences.zh: 詔贈太子少師。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 光鄴膚革肥皙，善於攝養，故司天監趙延乂有袁、許之術，嘗謂人曰：「翟君外厚而內薄，雖貴而無壽。」

translations.literal: Guangye's skin was plump and fair and he was skilled at nurturing himself; therefore Astronomical Commissioner Zhao Yanyi, who had the arts of Yuan and Xu, once told others, "Master Di is thick outside but thin within; though honored he will not live long.
translations.idiomatic: Guangye's skin was plump and fair and he was skilled at tending his health; the Astronomical Commissioner Zhao Yanyi, versed in the arts of Yuan and Xu, once told others, "Master Di is thick outside but thin within; though he rises high he will not live long.

sentences.zh: 果如其言。

translations.literal: It turned out exactly as he had said.
translations.idiomatic: It turned out exactly as he had said.

sentences.zh: 曹英，字德秀，舊名犯今上御名，故改焉。

translations.literal: Cao Ying, style name Dexiu, had an original name that violated the present emperor's taboo name and was therefore changed.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Ying, whose style name was Dexiu, bore an original given name that violated the present emperor's taboo and was therefore changed.

sentences.zh: 本常山鎮定人也。

translations.literal: He was originally a native of Zhen in Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: He was originally from Zhen in Changshan.

sentences.zh: 父全武，事趙王王镕為列校，英因得隸於镕之帳下。

translations.literal: His father Quanwu served Prince Zhao Wang Rong as a company commander, and Ying thereby came to serve in Rong's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: His father Quanwu had served Prince Zhao Wang Rong as a company commander, and Ying came to serve in Rong's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 及張文禮之亂，唐莊宗奄有其地，乃錄镕之左右，署為散指揮使。

translations.literal: When Zhang Wenli's rebellion broke out, Tang Zhuangzong suddenly seized that territory and enrolled Rong's attendants, appointing Ying a scattered commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Wenli rebelled, Zhuangzong of Tang suddenly seized the region and enrolled Rong's attendants, appointing Ying a scattered commander.

sentences.zh: 明宗即位，英侍於仗下，問其祖考，英以實對，明宗曰：「乃朕之舊也。」

translations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne Ying attended below the imperial halberds; the emperor asked about his forebears and Ying answered truthfully; Mingzong said, "So you are one of my old associates.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong acceded, Ying stood attendance below the imperial halberds; the emperor asked about his forebears and Ying answered truthfully; Mingzong said, "So you are one of my old associates.

sentences.zh: 擢為本班行首，每加顧遇。

translations.literal: He was promoted to head of his guard company and received repeated favor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to head of his guard company and won repeated favor.

sentences.zh: 晉天福中，遷弩手軍使。

translations.literal: During Jin Tianfu he was transferred to commander of the Crossbow Hand Army.
translations.idiomatic: During Jin Tianfu he was transferred to commander of the Crossbow Hand Army.

sentences.zh: 平張從賓於汜水，以功授本軍都校。

translations.literal: When Zhang Congbin was pacified at Sishui he was given command of his own army's company for merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Congbin was pacified at Sishui he was made company commander of his own army for his merit.

sentences.zh: 漢初，改奉國軍主，加檢校司徒，兼康州刺史。

translations.literal: Early in Han he was made commander of the Fengguo Army, given the acting title Minister of Works, and concurrently made prefect of Kang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Han he was made commander of the Fengguo Army, given the acting title Minister of Works, and concurrently prefect of Kang.

sentences.zh: 乾祐初，李守貞據河中叛，授行營步軍都校。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyou, when Li Shouzhen held Hezhong in rebellion, he was appointed company commander of the campaign army's infantry.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyou year one, when Li Shouzhen held Hezhong in rebellion, he was appointed company commander of the campaign army's foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 河中平，遷本軍廂主，領岳州防禦使。

translations.literal: When Hezhong was pacified he was transferred to commander of his army's wing and given nominal charge as defense commissioner of Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Hezhong was pacified he was made wing commander of his army and given nominal charge as defense commissioner of Yue.

sentences.zh: 隨太祖在魏，為北面行營步軍都校，從平內難。

translations.literal: Following Taizu at Wei he served as company commander of the northern campaign army's infantry and took part in pacifying the internal crisis.
translations.idiomatic: Following Taizu at Wei he served as company commander of the northern campaign army's foot soldiers and helped quell the internal crisis.

sentences.zh: 國初，以翊戴功授昭武節度使、檢校太傅、侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state, for his merit in supporting the enthronement he was made military governor of Zhaowu, acting Grand Tutor, and commander of the palace guard infantry.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the dynasty, for his merit in supporting the enthronement he was made military governor of Zhaowu, acting Grand Tutor, and commander of the palace guard foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 二年春，總兵討慕容彥超於兗州，梯沖塹壘，頗有力焉。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year he led troops against Murong Yanchao at Yan Prefecture; in assault ladders, rams, ditches, and ramparts he contributed considerable strength.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year two he led troops against Murong Yanchao at Yan Prefecture; in scaling ladders, rams, ditches, and ramparts he played a major part.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，太祖親征，因並兵攻陷其城，及凱旋，領彰信軍節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer Taizu campaigned in person; the armies were combined and the city stormed and taken; on the triumphal return he was given charge of Zhangxin Army while retaining command of the troops as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Taizu campaigned in person; the armies were combined, the city stormed and taken; on the return in triumph he was given Zhangxin Army while keeping command of the troops as before.

sentences.zh: 世宗嗣位，加同平章事，授成德軍節度使。

translations.literal: When Shizong succeeded he was given the title of Councilor and made military governor of Chengde.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong succeeded he was made a Councilor and military governor of Chengde.

sentences.zh: 車駕自太原回，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned from Taiyuan he was given the additional title of Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned from Taiyuan he was given the additional title of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 顯德元年冬，卒於鎮，時年四十九。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Xiande he died at his post, aged forty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Xiande year one he died at his post, aged forty-nine.

sentences.zh: 制贈中書令。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 英性沈厚，謙恭有禮，雖衽席之際，接對賓客，亦未嘗造次。

translations.literal: Ying's nature was deep and steady, humble and courteous; even at his own mat he never treated guests rashly when receiving them.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was deep and steady by nature, humble and courteous; even beside his own mat he never treated guests with casual abruptness.

sentences.zh: 及卒，搢紳之士亦皆惜之。

translations.literal: When he died the gentry also all mourned him.
translations.idiomatic: When he died, men of the gentry mourned him as well.

sentences.zh: 李彥頵，字德循，太原人也。

translations.literal: Li Yanyun, style name Dexun, was a native of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yanyun, whose style name was Dexun, came from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 本以商賈為業，太祖鎮鄴，置之左右，及即位，歷綾錦副使、搉易使。

translations.literal: He had originally been a merchant; when Taizu governed Ye he placed him at his side, and after the accession he successively served as deputy commissioner of brocade and silk and as commissioner of the state monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: He had originally been a merchant; when Taizu governed Ye he kept Yanyun at his side, and after the accession Yanyun served in turn as deputy commissioner of brocade and silk and as monopoly commissioner.

sentences.zh: 世宗嗣位，以彥頵有舊，超授內客省使。

translations.literal: When Shizong succeeded, because Yanyun was an old associate he was abruptly appointed Commissioner of the Inner Guests Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong succeeded, because Yanyun was an old associate he was abruptly made Commissioner of the Inner Guests Directorate.

sentences.zh: 未幾，知相州軍府事，尋改延州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: Before long he was made administrator of Xiang Prefecture's military government; soon afterward he was changed to military commander of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was put in charge of Xiang Prefecture's military government; soon afterward he was made military commander of Yan.

sentences.zh: 到鎮，頗以殖貨為意，窺圖剩利，侵漁蕃漢部人，群情大擾。

translations.literal: On reaching his post he was much intent on amassing wealth, scheming for surplus profit and plundering both tribal and Han subjects until popular feeling was greatly disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Once at his post he was much intent on amassing wealth, scheming for surplus profit and squeezing both tribal and Han subjects until the region was in uproar.

sentences.zh: 會世宗南征，蕃部結聚，圍迫州城，彥頵閉壁自守，求援於鄰道，賴救兵至，乃解。

translations.literal: When Shizong marched south the tribal peoples gathered and pressed the prefectural city; Yanyun shut the walls and held out, sought aid from neighboring circuits, and only when relief troops arrived was the siege lifted.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong marched south the tribal peoples gathered and pressed the prefectural city; Yanyun shut the walls and held out, sought aid from neighboring circuits, and only when relief arrived was the siege lifted.

sentences.zh: 世宗不悅，征赴京師，然猶委曲庇護，竟不之責。

translations.literal: Shizong was displeased and summoned him to the capital, yet still sheltered him tactfully and in the end did not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong was displeased and summoned him to the capital, yet still sheltered him tactfully and in the end did not hold him accountable.

sentences.zh: 尋為西京水南巡檢使，居無何，命權知泗州軍州事，改滄州兩使留後。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was made inspector of the Western Capital's south-of-the-water circuit; before long he was ordered to act as military governor of Si Prefecture and then made dual commissioner of Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made inspector of the Western Capital's south-of-the-water circuit; before long he was ordered to act as military governor of Si and then made dual commissioner of Cang.

sentences.zh: 彥頵到任，處置乖方，大為物情所鄙。

translations.literal: When Yanyun took up his post his arrangements were ill judged and he was widely despised in public sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: When Yanyun took up his post his arrangements were ill judged and public opinion held him in contempt.

sentences.zh: 顯德六年秋，受代歸闕，遇疾而卒，時年五十有二。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the sixth year of Xiande he was relieved and returned to court; he fell ill on the way and died, aged fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Xiande year six he was relieved and returned to court; he fell ill on the way and died, aged fifty-two.

sentences.zh: 李暉，字順光，瀛州束城人。

translations.literal: Li Hui, style name Shunguang, was a native of Dongcheng in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hui, whose style name was Shunguang, came from Dongcheng in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 弱冠應募於龍驤軍，漢祖領河東，暉請從，因得署為河東牙將。

translations.literal: In his youth he enlisted in the Dragon Soaring Army; when the Han founder took charge of Hedong, Hui asked to follow and was appointed a Hedong military adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth he enlisted in the Dragon-Soaring Army; when the Han founder took charge of Hedong, Hui asked to follow him and was appointed a Hedong military adjutant.

sentences.zh: 漢有天下，授檢校司徒、大內皇城使。

translations.literal: When Han held the realm he was given the acting title Minister of Works and made commissioner of the Inner Imperial City.
translations.idiomatic: When Han held the empire he was given the acting title Minister of Works and made commissioner of the Inner Imperial City.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷宣徽南院使。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Commissioner of the Southern Palace Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to Commissioner of the Southern Palace Directorate.

sentences.zh: 乾祐初，拜河陽節度使、檢校太傅。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyou he was appointed military governor of Heyang and acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyou year one he was appointed military governor of Heyang and acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 太祖登極，加同平章事，尋移鎮滄州。

translations.literal: When Taizu took the throne he was given the title of Councilor and soon transferred to govern Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu took the throne he was made a Councilor and soon transferred to Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 顯德元年，就加兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xiande he was given the additional title of Palace Attendant on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiande year one he was given the additional title of Palace Attendant in situ.

sentences.zh: 二年秋，以世宗誕慶節來朝，改邠州節度使。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year he came to court for Shizong's birthday celebration and was transferred to military governor of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of year two he came to court for Shizong's birthday celebration and was transferred to military governor of Bin.

sentences.zh: 五年，移鎮鳳翔。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to govern Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In year five he was transferred to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，卒於鎮。

translations.literal: After a little more than a year he died at his post.
translations.idiomatic: A little more than a year later he died at his post.

sentences.zh: 優詔贈中書令。

translations.literal: A gracious edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: A gracious edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 暉之儀貌不及於常人，而位極將相，年登耳順，袁、許之術，夫何恃哉！

translations.literal: Hui's bearing and appearance fell short of ordinary men, yet he rose to the summit of general and minister, lived to the age of sixty—what did he rely on from the arts of Yuan and Xu!
translations.idiomatic: Hui's looks fell short of the ordinary, yet he rose to the summit of general and minister and lived to sixty—what need had he of the arts of Yuan and Xu!

sentences.zh: 然性貪鄙，而好小惠以邀虛譽，故在河陽及滄州日，民皆詣闕請立碑以頌其美，識者亦未之許也。

translations.literal: Yet by nature he was greedy and base, and liked petty favors to win empty praise; therefore while at Heyang and Cang Prefecture the people all went to court asking to erect steles praising his virtue, yet the knowing did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was greedy and base by nature and liked petty favors to win empty praise; so while at Heyang and Cang the people all petitioned the court to erect steles praising his virtue, but the discerning did not approve.

sentences.zh: 李建崇，潞州人。

translations.literal: Li Jianchong was a native of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jianchong came from Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 少從軍，善騎射。

translations.literal: In his youth he joined the army and was skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth he took up arms and was skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 初事唐武皇，為鐵林都將，轉突騎、飛騎二軍使。

translations.literal: He first served Tang Wuhuang as commander of the Iron Forest Guard, then became commander of the Sudden Cavalry and Flying Cavalry armies.
translations.idiomatic: He first served Wuhuang of Tang as a commander of the Iron Forest Guard, then rose to command the Sudden Cavalry and Flying Cavalry armies.

sentences.zh: 從莊宗攻常山，阿保機來援，莊宗率親軍千騎，遇於滿城，兵少，為契丹所圍。

translations.literal: Following Zhuangzong's attack on Changshan, Abaoji came to their aid; Zhuangzong led a thousand horse of the personal army, met them at Mancheng, had too few troops, and was surrounded by the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong attacked Changshan, Abaoji came to the enemy's aid; Zhuangzong led a thousand horse of his personal guard, met them at Mancheng with too few men, and was surrounded by the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 時建崇為親將，與契丹格鬥，自午至申，會李嗣昭騎至，契丹乃解去。

translations.literal: Jianchong was then a personal commander; he fought the Khitan from the noon hour to the shen hour; when Li Sizhao's cavalry arrived the Khitan withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchong was then a commander of the personal guard; he fought the Khitan from noon to late afternoon, until Li Sizhao's cavalry arrived and the Khitan broke off.

sentences.zh: 同光中，自龍武捧聖都指揮使，出歷襄、秦、徐、雍都指揮使。

translations.literal: During Tongguang he rose from commander of the Dragon Martial Fengsheng Guard to successively serve as army commander of Xiang, Qin, Xu, and Yong.
translations.idiomatic: During Tongguang he rose from commander of the Dragon Martial Fengsheng Guard to serve in turn as army commander of Xiang, Qin, Xu, and Yong.

sentences.zh: 建崇性純厚，處身任遇，不能巧宦，以致久滯偏裨。

translations.literal: Jianchong's nature was simple and honest; in conduct and appointment he could not practice clever office-holding, so he long remained at subordinate ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchong was plain and honest by nature; in how he carried himself and won appointments he could not play the courtier, and so long remained a subordinate officer.

sentences.zh: 明宗嘗掌牙兵，與建崇共事，及即位，甚湣之，連授磁、沁二郡。

translations.literal: Mingzong had once commanded the guard troops and worked with Jianchong; when he took the throne he pitied him greatly and successively gave him Ci and Qin prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong had once commanded the guard troops alongside Jianchong; when he took the throne he pitied him deeply and in succession gave him Ci and Qin.

sentences.zh: 入晉為申州刺史。

translations.literal: Entering Jin service he became prefect of Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin service he became prefect of Shen.

sentences.zh: 天福七年冬，襄州安從進構逆，率眾寇南陽，時建崇領步騎千餘屯於葉縣，開封尹鄭王遣宣徽使張從恩、皇城使焦繼勛率在京諸軍，會建崇軍拒賊，至湖陽縣之花山，遇從進軍，建崇接戰，大敗之，以功授亳州團練使。

translations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year of Tianfu, An Congjin of Xiangyang plotted rebellion and led troops to raid Nanyang; Jianchong then led more than a thousand foot and horse stationed at Ye County; the Prince of Zheng as Kaifeng intendant sent Palace Commissioner Zhang Congen and Imperial City Commissioner Jiao Jixun to lead the capital armies, join Jianchong's force to resist the rebels, and at Huashan in Huyang County met Congjin's army; Jianchong engaged and routed them, and for merit was made regimental commissioner of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Tianfu year seven, An Congjin of Xiangyang rebelled and led troops against Nanyang; Jianchong then commanded more than a thousand foot and horse at Ye County; the Prince of Zheng, as Kaifeng intendant, sent Palace Commissioner Zhang Congen and Imperial City Commissioner Jiao Jixun with the capital armies to join Jianchong; at Huashan in Huyang they met Congjin's force, Jianchong gave battle and routed them, and for his merit was made regimental commissioner of Bo.

sentences.zh: 襄陽平，遷安州防禦使。

translations.literal: When Xiangyang was pacified he was transferred to defense commissioner of An.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiangyang was pacified he was transferred to defense commissioner of An.

sentences.zh: 歷河陽、邢州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: He successively served as military commander of Heyang and Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as military commander of Heyang and Xing.

sentences.zh: 漢初，入為右衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Early in Han he entered service as Grand General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Han he entered court service as Grand General of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 年逾七十，神氣不衰。

translations.literal: Past seventy, his spirit and vigor did not decline.
translations.idiomatic: Past seventy, his spirit and vigor had not waned.

sentences.zh: 建崇始自代北事武皇，至是四十餘年，前後所掌兵，麾下部曲多至節鉞，零落殆盡，惟建崇雖位不及藩屏，而康強自適，以至期耄。

translations.literal: Jianchong had served Wuhuang from the northern Dai region; by now more than forty years had passed; of the troops he had commanded, many subordinates had risen to military governorships and nearly all had fallen away—only Jianchong, though his rank never reached a frontier command, remained hale and at ease even to extreme old age.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchong had followed Wuhuang from the northern frontier; by now more than forty years had passed; of the troops he had led, many subordinates had risen to military governorships and nearly all were gone—only Jianchong, though he never reached a frontier command, stayed hale and content even to great old age.

sentences.zh: 太祖即位，授左監門衛上將軍。

translations.literal: When Taizu took the throne he was appointed Grand General of the Left Directorate of the Gate Guards.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu acceded he was appointed Grand General of the Left Directorate of the Gate Guards.

sentences.zh: 廣順三年春卒。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year of Guangshun he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Guangshun year three he died.

sentences.zh: 贈黔南節度使。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as military governor of Qiannan.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as military governor of Qiannan.

sentences.zh: 王重裔，陳州宛丘人。

translations.literal: Wang Zhongyi was a native of Wancheng in Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhongyi came from Wancheng in Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父達，歷安、均、洺三州刺史，因家於洺。

translations.literal: His father Da served successively as prefect of An, Jun, and Luo and settled his family at Luo.
translations.idiomatic: His father Da had served in turn as prefect of An, Jun, and Luo and made his home at Luo.

sentences.zh: 重裔幼沈厚有勇，善騎射。

translations.literal: Zhongyi in youth was grave, steady, and brave and skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyi in youth was grave, brave, and skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 年未及冠，事莊宗為廳直，管契丹直。

translations.literal: Before he came of age he served Zhuangzong as hall attendant and managed the Khitan guard.
translations.idiomatic: Before he came of age he served Zhuangzong as a hall attendant and managed the Khitan guard.

sentences.zh: 從安汴、洛，累為禁軍指揮使。

translations.literal: Following the pacification of Bian and Luo he successively served as commander of the palace guard armies.
translations.idiomatic: Following the pacification of Bian and Luo he rose through commands of the palace guard armies.

sentences.zh: 晉天福中，鎮州安重榮謀叛，稱兵指闕，朝廷命杜重威率師拒之，賊陣於宗城東，晉遣齊軍擊之，再合不動。

translations.literal: During Jin Tianfu, An Chongrong of Zhen Prefecture plotted rebellion and raised troops toward the capital; the court ordered Du Chongwei to lead an army to resist; the rebels formed battle lines east of Zongcheng; Jin sent the Qi army to attack; twice they joined battle without movement.
translations.idiomatic: During Jin Tianfu, An Chongrong of Zhen plotted rebellion and marched on the capital; the court ordered Du Chongwei to resist; the rebels formed east of Zongcheng; Jin sent the Qi army to strike; twice they clashed without breaking the stalemate.

sentences.zh: 杜重威懼，謀欲抽退，重裔曰：「兵家忌退，但請公分麾下兵擊其兩翼，重裔為公陷陣，當其中軍，彼必狼狽矣。」

translations.literal: Du Chongwei was afraid and planned to withdraw; Zhongyi said, "In warfare withdrawal is taboo—only ask the Duke to divide your troops to strike both wings; Zhongyi will break the enemy line for you and take their center army—they will surely be thrown into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chongwei feared and planned to pull back; Zhongyi said, "Armies dread retreat—only divide your troops to strike both wings; Zhongyi will break the line for you and take their center—they will surely fall into disorder.

sentences.zh: 重威從之，重榮即時退蹙，遂敗。

translations.literal: Chongwei followed this; Chongrong at once fell back in disorder and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Chongwei agreed; Chongrong at once broke and fell back and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 以功遷護聖右廂都指揮使，領費州刺史。

translations.literal: For merit he was transferred to commander of the right wing of the Fengsheng Guard and given charge of Fei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was made commander of the right wing of the Fengsheng Guard and given Fei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 漢初，仍典禁軍，從征鄴都平，遷深州刺史。

translations.literal: Early in Han he still commanded the palace guard and followed the campaign to pacify Yedu, then was transferred to prefect of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Han he still commanded the palace guard, followed the campaign that pacified Yedu, and was transferred to prefect of Shen.

sentences.zh: 淮夷以李守貞故，數侵邊地，以重裔為亳州防禦使，又令於徐州巡檢，兼知軍州，就加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Because the Huai tribes, on account of Li Shouzhen, repeatedly raided the border, Zhongyi was made defense commissioner of Bozhou and also ordered to inspect at Xuzhou while concurrently administering the military government, and on the spot was given the acting title Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Huai tribes, on Li Shouzhen's account, repeatedly raided the frontier, Zhongyi was made defense commissioner of Bo and also ordered to inspect at Xu while concurrently administering the prefecture, and was given the acting title Grand Tutor on the spot.

sentences.zh: 太祖踐阼，加爵邑，改功臣。

translations.literal: When Taizu took the throne he increased his noble rank and fief and changed his merit title.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu acceded he increased his noble rank and fief and changed his merit title.

sentences.zh: 廣順元年夏，以疾卒，年五十有三。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Guangshun he died of illness, aged fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Guangshun year one he died of illness, aged fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 贈武信軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as military governor of Wuxin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as military governor of Wuxin.

sentences.zh: 孫漢英，太原人也。

translations.literal: Sun Hanyin was a native of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Hanyin came from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 父重進，事唐武皇、莊宗為大將，賜姓，名存進，《唐書》有傳。

translations.literal: His father Chongjin served Tang Wuhuang and Zhuangzong as a great general, was granted the imperial surname, and named Cunjin; the 《Tang History》 has his biography.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chongjin had served Wuhuang and Zhuangzong of Tang as a great general, was granted the imperial surname, and took the name Cunjin; the 《Tang History》 has his biography.

sentences.zh: 漢英少事戎伍，稍至都將，嘗為東面馬步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Hanyin in youth entered the army and in time rose to company commander; he once served as commander of the eastern face foot and horse armies.
translations.idiomatic: Hanyin entered the army young and in time rose to company commander; he once commanded the eastern face foot and horse armies.

sentences.zh: 清泰初，興元節度使張虔釗失律於岐下，遂以其地西臣於蜀，漢英兄漢韶，時為洋州節度使，因茲阻隔，亦送款於蜀，由是漢英與弟漢筠久之不調。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingtai, Zhang Qianzhao, military governor of Xingyuan, lost the battle at Qi and thereby submitted that territory to Shu in the west; Hanyin's elder brother Hanshao was then military governor of Yang and was cut off, also submitting to Shu; therefore Hanyin and his younger brother Hanjun long went without promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingtai year one Zhang Qianzhao of Xingyuan lost at Qi and submitted that territory west to Shu; Hanyin's elder brother Hanshao, then military governor of Yang, was cut off and also submitted to Shu; Hanyin and his younger brother Hanjun long went without promotion.

sentences.zh: 漢乾祐中，太祖西征蒲、雍，以漢英戚裏之分，奏於軍中指使。

translations.literal: In Qianyou of Han, Taizu campaigned west against Pu and Yong and, because Hanyin was a relation by marriage, memorialized that he be assigned command in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In Han Qianyou, Taizu campaigned west against Pu and Yong and, because Hanyin was kin by marriage, had him assigned command in the army.

sentences.zh: 蒲、雍平，班師，隱帝以漢英為絳州刺史、檢校司徒。

translations.literal: When Pu and Yong were pacified and the army returned, the Hidden Emperor made Hanyin prefect of Jiang and acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Pu and Yong were pacified and the army returned, the Hidden Emperor made Hanyin prefect of Jiang and acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 廣順元年冬，卒於都。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Guangshun he died at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Guangshun year one he died at the capital.

sentences.zh: 許遷，鄆州人也。

translations.literal: Xu Qian was a native of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qian came from Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初為本州牙將，性剛褊。

translations.literal: He first served as a military adjutant of his prefecture; his nature was stern and narrow.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as a military adjutant in his home prefecture; he was stern and narrow by nature.

sentences.zh: 漢乾祐初，為左屯衛將軍，與少府監馬從斌同監造漢祖山陵法物，節財省用，減數萬計。

translations.literal: In the first year of Han Qianyou he was Left Colonel of the Garrison Guard and together with Vice Director of the Palace Storehouses Ma Congbin supervised the making of ritual objects for Gaozu's mausoleum, economizing materials and saving tens of thousands in cost.
translations.idiomatic: In Han Qianyou year one he was Left Colonel of the Garrison Guard and, with Vice Director Ma Congbin, supervised ritual objects for Gaozu's tomb, saving materials and cutting costs by tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 改左監門大將軍，又加檢校司空。

translations.literal: He was changed to Grand General of the Left Directorate of the Gate Guards and also given the acting title Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Grand General of the Left Directorate of the Gate Guards and given the acting title Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 漢末，權知隰州。

translations.literal: Late in Han he was acting prefect of Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Han he acted as prefect of Xi.

sentences.zh: 太祖踐阼，劉崇遣子鈞率兵寇平陽，路由於隰，賊眾攻城，城中兵少，遷感激指諭，士鬥兼倍，賊眾傷夷，尋自退去。

translations.literal: When Taizu took the throne, Liu Chong sent his son Jun to lead troops to raid Pingyang; their route passed Xi; the rebels besieged the city; troops inside were few; Qian stirred them with emotion and instruction and the soldiers fought twice as hard; the rebel host suffered casualties and soon withdrew on their own.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu acceded, Liu Chong sent his son Jun to raid Pingyang; the route passed Xi; rebels besieged the city with few defenders inside; Qian roused the men with passionate exhortation and they fought twice as hard; the rebels suffered heavy losses and soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 太祖降詔撫諭，正授隰州刺史。

translations.literal: Taizu issued an edict of comfort and formally appointed him prefect of Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu issued a comforting edict and formally appointed him prefect of Xi.

sentences.zh: 遷切於除盜，嫉惡過當，或釘磔賊人，令部下臠割。

translations.literal: Qian was zealous in eliminating bandits and hated evil beyond measure; sometimes he nailed or dismembered bandits and had his subordinates carve them up.
translations.idiomatic: Qian was zealous in rooting out bandits and hated evil to excess; sometimes he nailed or dismembered thieves and had his men carve them up.

sentences.zh: 誤斷不合死罪人，其家詣闕致訟，詔下開封府獄。

translations.literal: He wrongly executed a man who did not deserve death; the family went to court to sue; an edict sent the case to the Kaifeng prefectural prison.
translations.idiomatic: He wrongly executed a man who should not have died; the family petitioned at court; an edict sent the case to Kaifeng prefectural prison.

sentences.zh: 時陳觀為知府，素與遷不協，深劾其事，欲追遷對訟，太祖以事狀可原，但罷郡而已。

translations.literal: Chen Guan was then prefect and had long been at odds with Qian; he impeached the matter deeply and wished to summon Qian to answer the suit; Taizu held the facts forgivable and only removed him from his prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guan was then prefect, had long been at odds with Qian, impeached him deeply, and wished to summon him to answer the suit; Taizu found the matter forgivable and only removed him from office.

sentences.zh: 遷既奉朝請，因大詬陳觀，謂王峻曰：「相公執政，所與參議，宜求賢德。

translations.literal: Once Qian was attending court as a petitioner he loudly reviled Chen Guan, telling Wang Jun, "When the Chancellor holds power, those with whom he deliberates should be sought for virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Once Qian attended court as a petitioner and loudly reviled Chen Guan, telling Wang Jun, "When the Chancellor holds power, those he consults should be men of virtue.

sentences.zh: 如陳觀者，為儒無家行，為官多任情，茍知其微，屠沽兒恥與為侶，況明公乎！」

translations.literal: Men like Chen Guan have no family conduct as Confucians and act capriciously in office; if they knew his true character, even butcher and peddler boys would be ashamed to keep his company—how much more a man of your stature!
translations.idiomatic: Men like Chen Guan have no family conduct befitting a scholar and act capriciously in office; if they knew his true character, even butchers and peddlers would scorn his company—how much more should you!

sentences.zh: 峻無以沮之。

translations.literal: Jun had no way to stop him.
translations.idiomatic: Jun had no way to silence him.

sentences.zh: 既而嬰疾，請告歸汶上而卒。

translations.literal: Before long he fell ill, asked leave, returned to Wen to die.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he fell ill, asked leave, returned to Wen, and died.

sentences.zh: 趙鳳，冀州棗強縣人，幼讀書，舉童子。

translations.literal: Zhao Feng was a native of Zaoqiang County in Ji Prefecture; in childhood he studied books and passed the child candidate examination.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Feng came from Zaoqiang in Ji Prefecture; as a boy he studied and passed the child-candidate examination.

sentences.zh: 既長，兇豪多力，以殺人暴掠為事，吏不能禁。

translations.literal: When grown he was a fierce bully of great strength and made killing and plunder his occupation; officials could not restrain him.
translations.idiomatic: Grown, he was a fierce bully of great strength who lived by killing and plunder; officials could not restrain him.

sentences.zh: 安重榮鎮常山，招集叛亡，鳳乃應募，既而犯法當死，即破械逾獄，遁而獲免。

translations.literal: When An Chongrong governed Changshan he recruited fugitives and rebels; Feng then enlisted; soon afterward he broke the law and deserved death, broke his fetters, leaped the prison wall, fled, and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: When An Chongrong held Changshan he recruited fugitives; Feng enlisted; soon he broke the law and deserved death, broke his fetters, leaped the prison wall, and escaped.

sentences.zh: 天福中，趙延壽為契丹鄉導，歲侵深、冀，鳳往依焉。

translations.literal: During Tianfu, Zhao Yanshou served as the Khitan guide; each year they raided Shen and Ji; Feng went to rely on him.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianfu, Zhao Yanshou guided the Khitan; year after year they raised Shen and Ji; Feng went to join him.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·荊罕儒傳》：罕儒少無賴，與趙鳳、張輦為群盜，晉天福中，相率詣范陽，委贄燕王趙延壽，得掌兵權。）〉

translations.literal: (《Song History·Biography of Jing Hanru》: In youth Hanru was a wastrel; with Zhao Feng and Zhang Nian he formed a band of robbers; in Jin Tianfu they went together to Fanyang, presented themselves to Prince Yan Zhao Yanshou, and gained command of troops.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (From the 《Song History·Biography of Jing Hanru》: Hanru in youth was a wastrel; with Zhao Feng and Zhang Nian he formed a band of robbers; in Jin Tianfu they went together to Fanyang, presented themselves to Prince Yan Zhao Yanshou, and gained command of troops.)〉

sentences.zh: 契丹主素聞其桀黠，署為羽林軍使，累遷羽林都指揮使，常令將兵在邊，貝、冀之民，日罹其患。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler had long heard of his fierceness and cunning and appointed him commander of the Feathered Forest Army; he rose to commander of the Feathered Forest Guard and was often ordered to lead troops on the frontier; the people of Bei and Ji daily suffered his harm.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler had long heard of his fierceness and appointed him commander of the Feathered Forest Army; he rose to commander of the Feathered Forest Guard, often led troops on the frontier, and the people of Bei and Ji suffered him daily.

sentences.zh: 晉末，契丹入洛，鳳從至東京，授宿州防禦使。

translations.literal: Late in Jin the Khitan entered Luoyang; Feng followed to the Eastern Capital and was appointed defense commissioner of Su.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Jin the Khitan entered Luoyang; Feng followed to the Eastern Capital and was made defense commissioner of Su.

sentences.zh: 漢祖即位，受代歸闕，尋授河陽行軍司馬。

translations.literal: When the Han founder took the throne Feng was relieved and returned to court; soon he was appointed march commander of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han founder acceded, Feng was relieved and returned to court; soon he was made march commander of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 乾祐初，入為龍武將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyou he entered service as Dragon Martial General.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyou year one he entered service as Dragon Martial General.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，起復授右千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: When his father's mourning ended he was recalled to service and appointed Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When his father's mourning ended he was recalled and appointed Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard.

sentences.zh: 漢末，都城變起，兵集之夜，無不剽之室，唯鳳里閭，兵不敢犯，人皆服其膽勇。

translations.literal: Late in Han when turmoil broke out in the capital, on the night troops gathered there was no house that was not looted—only Feng's neighborhood the soldiers did not dare violate; people all admired his bold courage.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Han, when turmoil broke out in the capital, on the night troops gathered no house escaped looting—only Feng's lane the soldiers did not dare touch; all admired his bold courage.

sentences.zh: 廣順初，用為宋、亳、宿三州巡檢使。

translations.literal: Early in Guangshun he was used as inspector of Song, Bo, and Su prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Guangshun he was made inspector of Song, Bo, and Su.

sentences.zh: 鳳出於伏莽，尤知盜之隱伏，乃誘致盜魁於麾下，厚待之，每桴鼓之發，無不擒捕，眾以為能，然平民因捕盜而破家者多矣。

translations.literal: Feng came from the wild hills and especially knew how bandits hid; he lured bandit chiefs into his following, treated them generously, and whenever the drums sounded for a raid none escaped capture—people thought him capable, yet many common families were ruined by his bandit-catching.
translations.idiomatic: Feng came from the wilds and knew how bandits hid; he lured bandit chiefs into his service, treated them well, and whenever drums sounded for a raid none escaped—people called him capable, yet many common families were ruined by his catching bandits.

sentences.zh: 鳳善事人，或使臣經由，靡不傾財厚奉，故得延譽而掩其醜跡。

translations.literal: Feng was skilled at courting people; whenever envoys passed through he would exhaust his wealth in lavish gifts, so he won praise that covered his ugly deeds.
translations.idiomatic: Feng was skilled at courting favor; whenever envoys passed he lavished gifts until he was poor, winning praise that masked his crimes.

sentences.zh: 太祖聞其幹事，用為單州刺史，既剛忿不仁，得位逾熾，刑獄之間，尤為不道。

translations.literal: Taizu heard of his competence and used him as prefect of Shan; once in office he was all the more fierce, cruel, and unkind, and in legal punishments he was especially lawless.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu heard of his ability and made him prefect of Shan; in office he grew fiercer, crueler, and more lawless in punishments.

sentences.zh: 嘗抑奪人之妻女，又以進奉南郊為名，率斂部民財貨，為人所訟。

translations.literal: He once seized others' wives and daughters, and under the name of presenting tribute for the southern suburban sacrifice he levied the people's goods until they sued him.
translations.idiomatic: He seized others' wives and daughters, and under the name of tribute for the southern suburban rite he extorted the people until they sued.

sentences.zh: 廣順三年十二月，詔削奪鳳在身官爵，尋令賜死。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year of Guangshun an edict stripped Feng of all his offices and ranks; soon he was ordered to commit suicide.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Guangshun year three an edict stripped Feng of all offices and ranks; soon he was ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 齊藏珍，少歷內職，累遷諸衛將軍。

translations.literal: Qi Cangzhen in youth held inner palace posts and rose through the various guard generalships.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Cangzhen in youth held inner-court posts and rose through the guard generalships.

sentences.zh: 前後監押兵師在外，頗稱幹事，然險诐無行，殘忍辯給，無不畏其利口。

translations.literal: He repeatedly supervised troops abroad and was praised as capable, yet he was treacherous and without conduct, cruel and glib, and none did not fear his sharp tongue.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly supervised troops abroad and was called capable, yet he was treacherous, cruel, and glib, and all feared his sharp tongue.

sentences.zh: 廣順中，奉命滑州界巡護河堤，以弛慢致河決，除名，配沙門島。

translations.literal: During Guangshun he was ordered to patrol the Yellow River dikes on the Hua Prefecture border; through negligence the river broke its banks; he was dismissed from office and exiled to Shamen Island.
translations.idiomatic: During Guangshun he patrolled the Yellow River dikes on the Hua border; through negligence the river broke through; he was dismissed and exiled to Shamen Island.

sentences.zh: 世宗在西班時，與藏珍同列，每聆其談論，或剖判世務，似有可采。

translations.literal: When Shizong was in the western class he and Cangzhen were colleagues; whenever he heard Cangzhen's talk, whether dissecting cases or judging affairs of the age, it seemed there was something to glean.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong sat in the western class he and Cangzhen were colleagues; Shizong often heard him discuss affairs and judge the times as though there were something worth taking.

sentences.zh: 及即位，自流所征還。

translations.literal: When he took the throne he was recalled from exile.
translations.idiomatic: When he acceded he was recalled from exile.

sentences.zh: 秦、鳳之役，令監偏師。

translations.literal: In the Qin-Feng campaign he was ordered to supervise a detached force.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qin-Feng campaign he was ordered to supervise a detached column.

sentences.zh: 及淮上用兵，復委監護，與軍校何超領兵降下光州。

translations.literal: When troops were used on the Huai he was again entrusted with supervision; with army commander He Chao he led troops to reduce Guang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the Huai campaign began he was again entrusted to supervise; with army commander He Chao he led troops to take Guang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 藏珍欺隱官物甚多，超以為不可，藏珍曰：「沙門島已有屋數間，不妨再去矣。」

translations.literal: Cangzhen concealed much government property; Chao thought this wrong; Cangzhen said, "Shamen Island already has several rooms—going again would not hurt.
translations.idiomatic: Cangzhen concealed much government property; Chao objected; Cangzhen said, "Shamen Island already has several rooms—it would not hurt to go again.

sentences.zh: 其不畏法也如此。

translations.literal: Such was his fearlessness of the law.
translations.idiomatic: Such was his contempt for the law.

sentences.zh: 世宗既破紫金山寨，追吳寇室渦口，因與藏珍言及克捷之狀。

translations.literal: After Shizong broke the Zijin Mountain camp and pursued the Wu enemy to Shiwokou, he spoke with Cangzhen of the victory.
translations.idiomatic: After Shizong broke the Zijin Mountain camp and pursued the Wu enemy to Shiwokou, he spoke with Cangzhen about the victory.

sentences.zh: 對曰：「陛下神武之功，近代無比，於文德則未光。」

translations.literal: He replied, "Your Majesty's martial achievement is unmatched in recent times, yet your civil virtue has not yet shone.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Your Majesty's martial achievement is unmatched in recent times, yet your civil virtue has not yet shone.

sentences.zh: 世宗頷之，又問以揚州之事，對曰：「揚州地實卑濕，食物例多腥腐。

translations.literal: Shizong nodded, and asked about Yangzhou; he replied, "Yangzhou's land is truly low and damp; food there is mostly rank and rotten.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong nodded and asked about Yangzhou; he replied, "Yangzhou's land is truly low and damp; food there is mostly rank and rotten.

sentences.zh: 臣去歲在彼，人以鱔魚饋臣者，視其盤中虬屈，一如蛇虺之狀，假使鸛雀有知，亦應不食，豈況於人哉！」

translations.literal: Last year when I was there, someone presented eel to me; looking at the dish they writhed like snakes—if even storks and magpies had sense they would not eat it, how much less men!"
translations.idiomatic: Last year when I was there, someone presented eel; in the dish they writhed like serpents—if storks and magpies had sense they would not eat it, how much less men!"

sentences.zh: 其敷奏大率多此類，聞者無不悚然。

translations.literal: His memorials were mostly of this sort; hearers were all struck with dread.
translations.idiomatic: His memorials were mostly of this kind; hearers were all struck with dread.

sentences.zh: 一日，又奏云：「唐景思已為刺史，臣猶未蒙聖澤。」

translations.literal: One day he again memorialized, "Jing Jingsi has already been made prefect, yet I have not yet received the sage's grace.
translations.idiomatic: One day he memorialized again, "Jing Jingsi has already been made prefect, yet I have not yet received Your Majesty's grace.

sentences.zh: 世宗俯而從之，時濠梁未下，即命為濠州行州刺史。

translations.literal: Shizong bowed his head and assented; Hao and Liang had not yet fallen, and he was at once made acting prefect on the Hao campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong assented; Hao and Liang had not yet fallen, and he was at once made acting prefect on the Hao campaign.

sentences.zh: 及張永德與李重進有間言，藏珍嘗遊說重進，洎壽陽兵回，諸將中有以藏珍之言上奏者。

translations.literal: When Zhang Yongde and Li Chongjin had a breach, Cangzhen once urged Chongjin; when the Shouyang army returned, among the generals some memorialized Cangzhen's words.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Yongde and Li Chongjin fell out, Cangzhen once urged Chongjin; when the Shouyang army returned, some generals memorialized what Cangzhen had said.

sentences.zh: 世宗怒，急召赴闕。

translations.literal: Shizong was angry and urgently summoned him to court.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong was angry and urgently summoned him to court.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，以其冒稱檢校官罪，按其事而斃之，蓋不欲暴其惡跡也。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year, for the crime of falsely claiming an acting official title, his case was investigated and he was executed—so as not to expose his wicked deeds publicly.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of year four, for falsely claiming an acting official title, his case was investigated and he was put to death—so as not to expose his wicked deeds openly.

sentences.zh: 王環，本真定人。

translations.literal: Wang Huan was originally a native of Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huan was originally from Zhending.

sentences.zh: 唐天成初，孟知祥鎮西川，環往事之，及知祥建號，環累典軍衛，孟昶嗣位，環兼領左、右衛。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tang Tiancheng, Meng Zhixiang governed the Western Chuan; Huan went to serve him; when Zhixiang declared a state Huan rose through military guard posts; when Meng Chang succeeded, Huan concurrently held the left and right guards.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang Tiancheng year one Meng Zhixiang governed Western Chuan; Huan served him; when Zhixiang declared a state Huan rose through guard commands; when Meng Chang succeeded, Huan held both left and right guards.

sentences.zh: 顯德二年秋，王師西伐，時環為鳳州節度使。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year of Xiande the imperial army campaigned west; Huan was then military governor of Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Xiande year two the imperial army marched west; Huan was then military governor of Feng.

sentences.zh: 初，偏師傅其城下，為環所敗，裨將胡立為環所擒。

translations.literal: At first a detached force reached his walls and was defeated by Huan; deputy general Hu Li was captured by Huan.
translations.idiomatic: At first a detached column reached his walls and was defeated by Huan; deputy commander Hu Li was captured.

sentences.zh: 是冬，王師大集，急攻其城，蜀之援兵相次敗走。

translations.literal: That winter the main army gathered and pressed the city hard; Shu relief armies were defeated in succession and fled.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the main army gathered and pressed the city; Shu relief armies were beaten in succession and fled.

sentences.zh: 環聞之，守備愈堅，王師攻擊數月方克。

translations.literal: When Huan heard this his defense grew firmer; the imperial army attacked for months before taking it.
translations.idiomatic: When Huan heard this his defense grew firmer; the imperial army attacked for months before the city fell.

sentences.zh: 城陷，環就擒。

translations.literal: When the city fell Huan was captured.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell Huan was taken.

sentences.zh: 及到闕，世宗以忠於所事，釋其罪，授若驍衛大將軍。

translations.literal: When he reached court Shizong, because he had been loyal to his master, pardoned his crime and appointed him Grand General of the Ruoxiao Guard.
translations.idiomatic: At court Shizong, because he had been loyal to his master, pardoned him and appointed him Grand General of the Ruoxiao Guard.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，世宗南征，環隨駕至泗州，遇疾而卒。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourth year Shizong campaigned south; Huan followed the carriage to Si Prefecture, fell ill, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year four Shizong marched south; Huan followed to Si, fell ill, and died.

sentences.zh: 張彥超，本沙陀部人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanchao was originally of the Shatuo tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanchao was originally of the Shatuo tribe.

sentences.zh: 素有郤克之疾，時號為「跛子」。

translations.literal: He had long had Xi Ke's affliction and was at the time called "the Lame One."
translations.idiomatic: He had long suffered Xi Ke's affliction and was known as "the Lame One."

sentences.zh: 初，以騎射事唐莊宗為馬直軍使，莊宗入汴，授神武指揮使。

translations.literal: At first, for his skill in mounted archery he served Tang Zhuangzong as commander of the Horse Guard Army; when Zhuangzong entered Bian he was appointed commander of the Divine Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: At first, for mounted archery he served Zhuangzong of Tang as commander of the Horse Guard Army; when Zhuangzong entered Bian he was made commander of the Divine Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 明宗嘗以為養子。

translations.literal: Mingzong once took him as an adopted son.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong once took him as a foster son.

sentences.zh: 天成中，擢授蔚州刺史。

translations.literal: During Tiancheng he was promoted and appointed prefect of Yu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng he was promoted to prefect of Yu.

sentences.zh: 素與晉高祖不協，屬其總戎於太原，遂舉其城投於契丹，即以為雲州節度使。

translations.literal: He had long been at odds with Jin Gaozu; when Gaozu commanded troops at Taiyuan he raised his city in surrender to the Khitan, who then made him military governor of Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He had long been at odds with Gaozu of Jin; when Gaozu commanded at Taiyuan he surrendered his city to the Khitan, who made him military governor of Yun.

sentences.zh: 契丹之南侵也，彥超率部眾，頗為鎮、魏之患。

translations.literal: When the Khitan invaded south, Yanchao led his troops and was a considerable trouble to Zhen and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan marched south, Yanchao led his troops and became a serious scourge to Zhen and Wei.

sentences.zh: 及契丹入汴，遷侍衛馬軍都校，尋授晉昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: When the Khitan entered Bian he was transferred to company commander of the palace guard cavalry and soon appointed military governor of Jinchang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan entered Bian he was made company commander of the palace guard horse army and soon military governor of Jinchang.

sentences.zh: 漢高祖入洛，彥超飛表輸誠，移授保大軍節度使。

translations.literal: When Han Gaozu entered Luoyang, Yanchao sent a swift memorial pledging loyalty and was transferred to military governor of Baoda.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu of Han entered Luoyang, Yanchao sent an urgent memorial pledging loyalty and was transferred to military governor of Baoda.

sentences.zh: 乾祐初，奉詔歸闕，止奉朝請而已。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianyou he was ordered by edict to return to court and held only the status of court petitioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianyou year one he was ordered back to court and held only the status of court petitioner.

sentences.zh: 太祖自鄴入平內難，隱帝令彥超董騎軍為拒，劉子陂兵亂，彥超先謁見太祖。

translations.literal: When Taizu entered from Ye to pacify the internal crisis, the Hidden Emperor ordered Yanchao to command the cavalry in resistance; at the disorder at Liuzi Slope, Yanchao was the first to call on Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu came from Ye to quell the internal crisis, the Hidden Emperor ordered Yanchao to command the cavalry against him; at the rout at Liuzi Slope, Yanchao was first to pay court to Taizu.

sentences.zh: 廣順中，授神武統軍。

translations.literal: During Guangshun he was appointed commander-in-chief of the Divine Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: During Guangshun he was appointed commander-in-chief of the Divine Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 顯德三年冬，以疾終於第。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year of Xiande he died of illness at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Xiande year three he died of illness at home.

sentences.zh: 制贈太子太師。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: By edict he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 張穎，太原人，駙馬都尉永德

translations.literal: Zhang Ying was a native of Taiyuan, son-in-law to Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-Law's Household Yongde
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ying came from Taiyuan; he was son-in-law to Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-Law's Household Yongde

sentences.zh: （《宋史》列傳：永德，并州陽曲人。

translations.literal: (《Song History》 biographies: Yongde was a native of Yangqu in Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: (《Song History》 biographies: Yongde came from Yangqu in Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 家世饒財，曾祖丕，尚氣節。

translations.literal: His family had been wealthy for generations; his great-grandfather Pi was high-spirited and principled.
translations.idiomatic: His family had been wealthy for generations; his great-grandfather Pi was high-spirited and principled.

sentences.zh: 後唐武皇鎮太原，急於用度，多嚴選富家子掌帑庫，或調度不給，即坐誅，沒入資產。

translations.literal: When Later Tang Wuhuang governed Taiyuan and urgently needed funds, he often strictly selected sons of rich families to manage the treasury; if supplies fell short they were executed and their assets confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuhuang of Later Tang governed Taiyuan and urgently needed funds, he often picked sons of rich families to manage the treasury; if supplies ran short they were executed and their assets seized.

sentences.zh: 丕為之滿歲，府財有餘。

translations.literal: Pi held the post a full year and the prefectural treasury had a surplus.
translations.idiomatic: Pi held the post a full year and the prefectural treasury had a surplus.

sentences.zh: 宗人政當次補其任，率族屬泣拜，請丕濟其急，丕又為代掌一年，鄉里服其義。）〉

translations.literal: A clansman Zheng was next in line for the post; he led the clan in weeping and bowing, asking Pi to relieve their distress, and Pi again took charge for a year—the countryside admired his righteousness.)〉
translations.idiomatic: A clansman Zheng was next in line; he led the clan in weeping and bowing, begging Pi to relieve their distress, and Pi again took charge for a year—the countryside admired his righteousness.)〉

sentences.zh: 之父也。

translations.literal: was his father.
translations.idiomatic: who was his father.

sentences.zh: 累為藩郡列校，由內職歷諸衛將軍。

translations.literal: He successively served as a company commander in frontier prefectures and rose through inner service to the various guard generalships.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as a company commander in frontier prefectures and rose through inner service to the guard generalships.

sentences.zh: 國初，以戚裏之故，自華州行軍司馬歷郢、懷二州刺史，遷安州防禦使。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state, because of kin by marriage, he rose from march commander of Hua to prefect of Ying and Huai, then defense commissioner of An.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the dynasty, through marriage kinship, he rose from march commander of Hua to prefect of Ying and Huai, then defense commissioner of An.

sentences.zh: 穎性卞急峻刻，不容人之小過，雖左右親信，亦皆怨之。

translations.literal: Ying's nature was harsh, impatient, stern, and unforgiving of the smallest fault; even close attendants on whom he relied all resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was harsh, impatient, stern, and unforgiving of the smallest fault; even his trusted attendants resented him.

sentences.zh: 部曲曹澄有處女，穎逼而娶之，澄遂與不逞之徒數人，同謀害穎，中夜挾刃入於寢門，執穎而殺之，遂奔於金陵。

translations.literal: His subordinate Cao Cheng had a virgin daughter; Ying forced her and married her; Cheng then joined several unruly men in a plot to kill Ying; in the middle of the night they took blades into the bedroom door, seized Ying and killed him, then fled to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinate Cao Cheng had a virgin daughter; Ying forced her into marriage; Cheng then joined several unruly men to kill Ying; in the dead of night they entered the bedroom with blades, seized Ying and killed him, then fled to Jinling.

sentences.zh: 世宗征淮南，以永德之故，遣江南李景，令執澄等送行在。

translations.literal: When Shizong campaigned against Huainan, because of Yongde he sent word to Li Jing of Jiangnan ordering Cheng and the others delivered to the imperial headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong campaigned against Huainan, for Yongde's sake he sent word to Li Jing of Jiangnan to deliver Cheng and the others to headquarters.

sentences.zh: 及至，世宗以澄等賜永德，俾甘心而戮之。

translations.literal: When they arrived Shizong gave Cheng and the others to Yongde so he might satisfy his heart by executing them.
translations.idiomatic: When they arrived Shizong gave Cheng and the others to Yongde to satisfy his heart by executing them.

sentences.zh: 劉仁贍，略通儒術，好兵書，在澤國甚有聲望。

translations.literal: Liu Renshan had some mastery of Confucian learning, loved military books, and in the marsh country enjoyed great repute.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Renshan had some mastery of Confucian learning, loved military books, and enjoyed great repute in the marsh country.

sentences.zh: 吳主知之，累遷為偽右監門衛將軍，歷黃、袁二州刺史，所至稱治。

translations.literal: The Wu ruler knew him and repeatedly promoted him to acting Grand General of the Right Directorate of the Gate Guards; he successively served as prefect of Huang and Yuan and wherever he went his rule was praised.
translations.idiomatic: The Wu ruler knew him and repeatedly promoted him to acting Grand General of the Right Directorate of the Gate Guards; he served in turn as prefect of Huang and Yuan and wherever he went his rule was praised.

sentences.zh: 洎李景僭襲偽位，俾掌親軍，遷鄂州節度使。

translations.literal: When Li Jing usurped the false throne he had him command the personal army and transferred him to military governor of E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jing usurped the false throne he put him in command of the personal army and made him military governor of E.

sentences.zh: 居數年，復以兵柄任之，改壽州節度使。

translations.literal: After several years he again entrusted him with military authority and changed him to military governor of Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After several years he again entrusted him with military authority and transferred him to military governor of Shou.

sentences.zh: 及王師渡淮，而仁贍固守甚堅。

translations.literal: When the imperial army crossed the Huai, Renshan defended with great firmness.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army crossed the Huai, Renshan held firm in defense.

sentences.zh: 洎世宗駐蹕於其壘北，數道齊攻，填塹陷壁，晝夜不息，如是者累月。

translations.literal: When Shizong halted north of his ramparts, several columns attacked together, filling ditches and breaching walls, day and night without cease, for months on end.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong encamped north of his ramparts, several columns attacked together, filling ditches and breaching walls day and night without cease for months.

sentences.zh: 世宗臨城以諭之，而仁贍但遜詞以謝。

translations.literal: Shizong came before the city to instruct him, but Renshan only answered with humble words of apology.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong came before the city to instruct him, but Renshan only answered with humble apologies.

sentences.zh: 及車駕還京，命李重進總兵守之，復乘間陷我南寨。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital he ordered Li Chongjin to command the troops holding the siege; Renshan again seized an opening and stormed our southern camp.
